d04ef21950c2a6cb.kind: Wildfire risk and insurance technology company
d04ef21950c2a6cb.identity_evidence: NAIC-hosted November 2024 presentation explicitly names Fortress Wildfire Insurance Group, LLC DBA FortressFire.
